data.name: Chicken Biryani
data.note: From Jalal Sam Fit (card: 508 kcal, P 47 · C 49 · F 13 for ¼ of the batch). Portions rescaled to the nutritionist's dinner target. Chicken is 100 g per serving, so one 600 g freezer pack makes 6 dinners. Spices and herbs are in the ingredient list in grams (converted from the spoon amounts) and count towards the nutrition. Spice amounts in the steps follow the servings you cook. Onion and green onion swapped for extra bell pepper (Anna). Chicken thighs (stehenní řízek) work just as well as breast here. Frozen mixed veg (150 g per portion) added for fibre. Regular butter replaces light butter (not sold in CZ), cut to about 73 % of the weight so fat and calories stay the same.
prepSteps: Thaw the chicken pack in the fridge the night before (about 24 hours for a 900 g pack). Pat the pieces dry before seasoning, since wet chicken steams instead of browning.

Cut the chicken ({=kureci-prsa}) into medium cubes. Mix with the yogurt ({=recky-jogurt-milko-0-3}), {q:5 cloves} minced garlic, {q:1 tbsp} grated ginger, {q:2 tsp} garam masala, {q:2 tsp} salt, {q:2 tsp} paprika, {q:2 tsp} ground cumin, {q:1 tsp} turmeric, three-quarters of the lemon juice ({=citronova-stava:75%|spoon}) and half the oil ({=olivovy-olej:50%|spoon}). Marinate 30 min, or overnight in the fridge for the best flavour.

Instead of crispy onion: slice the peppers ({=paprika}) thinly, toss with the rest of the oil ({=olivovy-olej:rest|spoon}) and roast at 190 °C for 10–12 min until charred at the edges. Watch they don't burn.
Rinse the rice ({=ryze}) until the water runs clear and cook it in salted water until just tender (about 12 min for basmati or long-grain). Drain.

Pan plan: {=kureci-prsa} of chicken is more than one pan can brown. Cook it in rounds of about 300 g in a single layer, or use two pans, and keep each finished round on a plate until the next step. If the browned bits on the pan turn dark brown or burn between rounds, deglaze with a splash of water or wipe the pan. To check, cut the thickest piece open: no pink, clear juices, firm all the way through.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with the butter ({=maslo}) and cook the chicken about 4 min a side until golden.

Lower the heat. Add half the roasted pepper ({=paprika:50%}), the chopped tomatoes ({=rajcata}), half the coriander ({=koriandr:50%}), {q:½ tsp} salt and {q:1 tsp} garam masala. Cover and cook 10 min on low, breaking the tomatoes down with a spatula into a thick sauce.

Layer in the pan: the chicken mix, rice, the rest of the lemon juice ({=citronova-stava:rest|spoon}), the rest of the roasted pepper ({=paprika:rest}) and the rest of the coriander ({=koriandr:rest}). Repeat once more. Cover on low for 5–10 min so the flavours mix.

Cook the frozen mixed veg ({=mrazena-zeleninova-smes}, a mix without onion) in the microwave or a steamer and divide everything into boxes. Keep the boxes open with the food no more than about 4 cm deep and leave it until it stops steaming, about 30 min. Rice must be in the fridge within 1 hour of cooking. Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking and close the lids once cool, not while warm.

data.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
data.note: From Jalal Sam Fit (card: 480 kcal, P 50 · C 39 · F 13 for ¼ of the batch). Portions rescaled to the nutritionist's dinner target. Spices and herbs are in the ingredient list in grams (converted from the spoon amounts) and count towards the nutrition. Spice amounts in the steps follow the servings you cook. Frozen mixed veg (100 g per portion) added for fibre. Regular butter replaces light butter (not sold in CZ), cut to about 73 % of the weight so fat and calories stay the same.
prepSteps: Trim the beef ({=hovezi-maso}) of silver skin, sinew and the outer fat and cut it across the grain into 2.5 cm cubes (bigger cubes stay juicy and get a better crust). Season with {q:1½ tsp} salt, {q:2 tsp} black pepper, {q:2 tsp} garlic powder, {q:2 tsp} parsley and the oil ({=olivovy-olej}). Marinate 30 min or more; overnight in the fridge is best.

Heat the oven to 200 °C. Wash the potatoes ({=brambory}) and cut them unpeeled into small cubes. Season with {q:1 tsp} each of salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder and parsley (oil optional) and bake 20–25 min until crispy.
Spicy mayo: mix the light mayo ({=majoneza-light-hellmann-s}), the sriracha ({=sriracha}) and the lemon juice ({=citronova-stava}). Keep it in a small pot.

Meanwhile heat a pan on medium-high with half the butter ({=maslo:50%|spoon}) and sear the beef in batches, 2–3 min a side, until it has a good crust. Take it out once the thickest piece is just cooked through, with no raw red in the middle (reheating finishes it).

Lower the heat, return all the beef with the rest of the butter ({=maslo:rest|spoon}), the minced garlic ({=cesnek}) and the chopped parsley ({=petrzel-nat}). Toss for 1–2 min, then take off the heat.
Divide the potatoes and steak bites into boxes.

Cook the frozen mixed veg ({=mrazena-zeleninova-smes}, a mix without onion) in the microwave or a steamer and add it to the boxes. Keep the boxes open with the food no more than about 4 cm deep and leave it until it stops steaming, about 30 min. Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking and close the lids once cool, not while warm.

data.name: Grilled Chicken Alfredo Pasta
data.note: From Jalal Sam Fit (card: 595 kcal, P 59 · C 50 · F 16 for ¼ of the batch). Portions rescaled to the nutritionist's dinner target. Chicken is 100 g per serving, so one 600 g freezer pack makes 6 dinners. Spices and herbs are in the ingredient list in grams (converted from the spoon amounts) and count towards the nutrition. Spice amounts in the steps follow the servings you cook. Onion and green onion swapped for extra bell pepper (Anna). Frozen mixed veg (150 g per portion) added for fibre. Regular butter replaces light butter (not sold in CZ), cut to about 73 % of the weight so fat and calories stay the same.
prepSteps: Thaw the chicken pack in the fridge the night before (about 24 hours for a 900 g pack). Pat the pieces dry before seasoning, since wet chicken steams instead of browning.

Cube the chicken ({=kureci-prsa}) and season with {q:1 tsp} salt, {q:2 tsp} Italian herbs, {q:1½ tsp} parsley, {q:1 tsp} chilli flakes (less if you don't like it spicy), {q:1½ tsp} garlic powder, {q:1½ tsp} paprika and the oil ({=olivovy-olej}). Mix until well coated.
Boil the pasta ({=testoviny}) in salted water for 8–10 min until al dente. Keep {q:60 ml} of the pasta water, then drain.

Pan plan: {=kureci-prsa} of chicken is more than one pan can brown. Cook it in rounds of about 300 g in a single layer, or use two pans, and keep each finished round on a plate until the next step. If the browned bits on the pan turn dark brown or burn between rounds, deglaze with a splash of water or wipe the pan. To check, cut the thickest piece open: no pink, clear juices, firm all the way through.

Heat a pan on medium-high with three-quarters of the butter ({=maslo:75%|spoon}) and cook the chicken 3–4 min a side for a nice golden crust. Lower the heat right down, add the rest of the butter ({=maslo:rest|spoon}), toss until coated and set aside.

In the same pan on low heat cook the chopped garlic ({=cesnek}) and the chopped pepper ({=paprika}, instead of onion) for 5 min until soft. Add {q:1 tsp} salt, {q:1 tsp} Italian herbs, {q:1 tsp} parsley, {q:½ tsp} chilli flakes and {q:1 tsp} paprika and stir for a minute.
Add the passata ({=rajcatove-pyre}) and cook on low for 5 min until it bubbles and thickens.

Stir in the light evaporated milk ({=zahustene-mleko-4}), light cream cheese ({=philadelphia-light}) and grated parmesan ({=parmazan-gran-moravia}) on low heat until creamy and smooth (add pasta water if too thick). Add the pasta and mix thoroughly. Box the pasta with the chicken on top.

Cook the frozen mixed veg ({=mrazena-zeleninova-smes}, a mix without onion) in the microwave or a steamer and divide everything into boxes. Keep the boxes open with the food no more than about 4 cm deep and leave it until it stops steaming, about 30 min. Refrigerate within 2 hours of cooking and close the lids once cool, not while warm.
